item.title: American Airlines No Longer Lets Customers Earn Miles on Basic Economy
item.description: The policy is another sign that the economy is skewing toward the wealthy and away from the Middle Class.

item.title: No Vote on NYC Bill to Ease Short-Term Rental Rules
item.description: A change is possible, but for now prospects for altering New York City's quasi ban of short-term rentals look darker than an alleyway in the Bowery.

item.title: OpenAI Breaks Open ChatGPT App Submissions
item.description: Any travel brand can now submit apps and get listed in its new app store — which means Booking.com and Expedia, early movers in OpenAI’s app ecosystem, will soon get new competition to own ChatGPT’s travel conversations.

item.title: Mexican Airline Mega-Merger: Volaris and Viva Announce Plan to Combine
item.description: This pre-Christmas announcement ensures regulators won’t be easing into the holidays. It's a seasonal surprise that’s likely to turn silent nights into sleepless ones for some.

item.title: Rove Bets on the ‘Hotelization’ of Workspaces with Its New ‘HQ by Rove’ Concept
item.description: Offices are no longer simply places where work happens — they’re lifestyle hubs. As companies struggle to bring employees back in person, HQ By Rove is demonstrating the power of hospitality-driven commercial workspaces where people actually want to spend their time.

item.title: ‘Double Trouble:’ AI’s Energy Demands Threaten Airlines’ Net-Zero Goals
item.description: Airlines are under pressure to decarbonize, but now they’re pointing fingers at AI for stealing the clean energy they need. The question is whether policymakers will listen.

item.title: Activist Investor Corvex Challenges Premier Inn Owner Over $4 Billion Plan
item.description: Whitbread is a year into a five-year strategy. Corvex wants it to stop and reassess. That puts pressure on the Premier Inn owner to justify its long-term plan.

item.title: Why Travel’s Biggest Brands Are Becoming Dangerously Boring
item.description: Some travel brands are making the same branding mistakes luxury fashion spent millions learning to regret.

item.title: What 10 Job Postings Tell Us About Disney’s AI Strategy for Travel
item.description: The company that pioneered MagicBands and transformed queue management into a science is, for now, treating AI as infrastructure rather than imagination when it comes to the guest journey itself. That may be prudent sequencing...or it may be a blind spot that someone else fills first.

item.title: TikTok’s U.S. Sale: A Reprieve for Travel Brands, or a Tech-Induced Headache?
item.description: TikTok inked a deal to sell a significant portion of its U.S. operation to American investors. The sale may bring clarity, but not comfort, as travel brands wait to see the effect on the algorithms driving discovery.
